title: Passive fire protection requirements for battery storage in residential settings
summary: Investigating passive fire protection for residential battery storage through battery fire characterisation, experiments and validated fire modelling. Wei guides research and experimental planning with the project researchers.

title: Fire safety for emerging renewable energy hazards
role: Chief Investigator, course coordinator and academic subject matter expert
summary: Developing microcredentials that equip practising professionals to assess emerging fire risks in energy systems and the built environment. Wei leads the microcredential on fire safety of emerging energy systems in buildings and infrastructure.

title: Hot Loads: Advancing fire tech for lithium battery fires in waste trucks
summary: An industry–research collaboration developing multi-sensor detection and early intervention technologies for lithium-ion battery fires in waste collection vehicles.

title: Bushfire-safe housing from mine tailings via Robotic 3D printing
summary: A collaborative project exploring mine-tailings-based materials and robotic 3D printing for bushfire-safe housing.

title: Multifunctional Biomass Coatings for Electrostatic Induced Fire Hazards
summary: Developing multifunctional biomass-based coatings to address fire hazards associated with static electricity, connecting materials chemistry, electrical behaviour and fire protection.
